lines.trans: Hello, restaurant, I want to reserve a table.
Max, for whom exactly are you booking a table?
For the famous Russian writer Viktor Pelevin.
Are you out of your mind, what Pelevin?
The administrator was very thrilled with such an important guest.
And what if Victoria knows what he looks like?
Pelevin is a mysterious writer, nobody has seen him.
What if there are his devoted readers in the restaurant?
They only saw his name on the cover.
How will Rodion be able to convincingly portray a genius?
He will simply put on dark black glasses.
I hope this crazy gamble will work today.

meanings.note: at an office, hotel, or cemetery
only when answering or making a phone call
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Why did it suddenly draw level?
I can see the toy car.
This artist is a true genius.
He has the talent of a genius.

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

examples.text: Макс решил забронировать столик на вечер.
examples.trans: Max decided to reserve a table for the evening.
A mysterious man was sitting in the corner.

examples.text: Он самый известный человек в городе.
examples.trans: He is the most famous man in town.
The actor was able to portray the hero excellently.

meanings.note: вот именно = that's just it, quite right

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.
Let's find out the winner's name.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know
in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.trans: He has a very kind face.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.en: to put on (an item of clothing)

examples.trans: He put on his best suit.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

examples.text: Портрет автора был на обложке книги.
examples.trans: The author's portrait was on the book's cover.
Vika was thrilled with the new famous guest.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: I love our town very much.
A famous writer came for lunch.
I am devoted to the chef.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.note: also a Russian man (as a noun)
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

meanings.en: to be able to, to manage to

examples.trans: We came as soon as we could.
Will you be able to come tomorrow morning?

сойти.gloss: to get off; (с ума) to go mad

meanings.en: to get off, to step down
сойти с ума = to go mad, to lose one's mind

examples.trans: What, have I lost my mind?

сработать.gloss: to work, succeed; to go off

meanings.en: to work, be effective, succeed (of a plan)

examples.text: Не сработает, но мужику жизнь испортим!
examples.trans: It won't work, and we'll ruin the man's life!
We will sit together in a friendly way at the table.

examples.text: Они заняли свободный столик у окна.
examples.trans: They took a free table near the window.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.text: На нём были большие тёмные очки.
examples.trans: He was wearing large dark glasses.

examples.text: Он говорил очень уверенно и убедительно.
examples.trans: He spoke very confidently and convincingly.

meanings.note: сойти с ума = to go mad, lose one's mind

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.

examples.text: Преданный читатель сразу узнал любимого автора.
examples.trans: The devoted reader immediately recognized his favorite author.
Listen, look in the black cabinet.

examples.text: На нём был строгий чёрный костюм.
examples.trans: He was wearing a formal black suit.
I'm sick of this communal flat.
